I am an old woman, and this small maize plot is just a corner of our land. I do not have cash to buy fertilizer from the cooperative — when it comes, it is often late and costly, and my household watches every birr. I will use the manure from our animals as I always have, and save seed from last year's harvest like my neighbors do. My children and grandchildren will help me weed and harvest; we do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece.
